entities.title: Layout, legibility and screen-reader text
entities.summary: Every screen, at its worst case, fits its regions, carries the footer, flashes only what it should, and has a text version.
criteria: No screen runs off the edge, out of its region, under the footer or into art
Every engine kind has a sample, and the flow shows only sampled kinds
Every screen drawn in full has the footer, and its cursor is the only flash
A held screen flashes only the alarm lamp or the rifle sight while it waits
The report never flashes and marks plots in words; debt shows a minus sign and a worded warning
The sound overlay restores the cells it covered, unless the screen was redrawn
Every string fits 32 columns and the font; data texts fit their 30-column regions
Every screen has screen-reader text, and alarms and deaths are assertive

entities.title: Pacing, keypad offers and sound
entities.summary: Held screens keep their time and then wait or move on as decided; every screen offers its keys; every motif parses to the art bible's notes.
criteria: Every motif parses into its stated number of notes and length
Held screens stay at least RULES §15.5's time reading no key, then show the any-key footer; a tap counts
Every screen waits for a key with a keypad offer
The screens the original timed move on by themselves 7 s after they appear; every other screen waits
The help list reads only digits, and a tap there counts for nothing
Keypad offers follow the UI design
The rating shows a line every 300 ms with a tally
